baseline_tools.name: get_issue
baseline_tools.description: Get a single issue by its ID, for example TRK-117. Returns the title, status, assignee, body and full comment thread.

candidate_tools.name: get_issue
candidate_tools.description: Get a single issue by its ID, for example TRK-117. Returns the title, status, assignee, body and full comment thread.

candidate_tools.name: list_issues
candidate_tools.description: List issues, optionally filtered by status and assignee. Use to browse or enumerate issues by those attributes; use search_issues to find issues by text in the title or body, and get_issue for one issue by ID. Returns at most 50 issues unless limit is set. Comments are included by default; set include_comments to false for smaller responses.

include_comments.description: Whether to include each issue's comments. Defaults to true; set false for a smaller response.

status.description: Filter by issue status. One of: open, in_progress, blocked, closed. Other values return an error.

candidate_tools.name: search_issues
candidate_tools.description: Search issues by case-insensitive text match against title and body. Use when you have keywords; use list_issues to filter by status or assignee, and get_issue for one issue by ID. Has no limit parameter and returns all matches. Comments are included by default; set include_comments to false for smaller responses.

include_comments.description: Whether to include each issue's comments. Defaults to true; set false for a smaller response.
